'''Eurybia''' is an independent system in the Core Systems, notable for hosting '''[[Demolition Unlimited]]''', the workshop of '''[[Liz Ryder]]''', one of the independent starting Engineers for explosive-weapon Engineering.<ref name="inara-eurybia">[https://inara.cz/elite/starsystem/17904/ Eurybia — Star System], Inara.</ref>

== Overview ==

* '''Star:''' Class K (scoopable)
* '''Allegiance:''' Independent
* '''Government:''' Anarchy
* '''Security:''' Anarchy
* '''Economy:''' Industrial / High Tech<ref name="inara-eurybia" />

{{Important|Eurybia has '''Anarchy''' security. There is no local security response to unlawful activity, so Commanders should be prepared for potential player and NPC threats while docked or in transit here.}}

== Engineer Facility ==

'''[[Demolition Unlimited]]''' is a surface Engineer base on the planet Makalu, operated by '''[[Liz Ryder]]'''.<ref name="inara-demolition">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52147/ Demolition Unlimited in Eurybia — Station], Inara.</ref>

No system permit is required to enter Eurybia. See [[Liz Ryder]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements for her workshop.
